description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class `JPAConfig` that sets up JPA (Java Persistence API) persistence unit, entity manager factory, and related beans for a project using EclipseLink as the JPA provider, within the Apache Fineract project. It includes configuration for auditing, repository scanning, vendor properties, and post-processors, indicating its role in JPA persistence layer setup.

classes.name: JPAConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class for setting up JPA EntityManagerFactory, vendor properties, auditing, and transaction support within the Fineract application.

methods.name: entityManagerFactory
methods.description: Defines the primary EntityManagerFactory bean, configured with data source, vendor properties, scan packages, and persistence unit settings.

methods.name: getVendorProperties
methods.description: Provides vendor-specific JPA properties for EclipseLink, incorporating custom customizers.

methods.name: getPackagesToScan
methods.description: Determines the set of packages that Hibernate should scan for entity classes.

methods.name: entityManagerFactoryBuilder
methods.description: Builds and customizes the EntityManagerFactoryBuilder, including setting post-processors.

methods.name: createJpaVendorAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns the EclipseLink JPA vendor adapter.

methods.name: auditorAware
methods.description: Provides an auditor aware bean for JPA auditing, returning user identifiers.

methods.name: txTemplate
methods.description: Provides a TransactionTemplate configured with the given transaction manager.
